findings: Solved 2026-10-30 on the owner's request (exercises book by book, in Practice): Chapter 8 exercise as printed on PDF 185-188 (printed pages 185-188), in the book's words and order. This exercise prints only Multiple Choice Questions and Short Answer Questions (no descriptive or numerical section).
Counts: 11 MCQs (Q.1 I-XI), 11 short questions (Q.2 a-k, of which j and k are calculations); all solved in English and Roman Urdu.

The book prints no answer key. MCQ keys worked out from the chapter: I c, II a, III b, IV c, V c, VI d, VII c, VIII c, IX a, X c, XI a. MCQ VII: Kp = Kc(RT)^Dn = 0.040 x 0.0821 x 723 = 2.37, about 2.4. MCQ V keyed (c), read as 'the effect of temperature on Kc depends on Delta H'.

Book corrections (boxes): MCQ II option (c) 'increase' for increases, and the word 'EXERCISE' printed after MCQ II instead of before the MCQs; short j prints Kc in Arabic-Indic (Urdu) numerals with a comma decimal, read as 0.020 (written in Latin digits, as the repo allows no Arabic script).
Not boxed: MCQ III option (c) is printed '[SO3]2/[SO3]2[O2]' (probably meant [SO3]2/[SO2]2[O2]); it is a wrong option either way and is kept as printed.
Calculations (the book prints no answers): short j Qc = (0.50 x 0.10)/2.0^2 = 0.0125 < Kc = 0.020, true statement (ii); short k [O2] = 0.050 - 0.020 = 0.030 mol dm-3 ([SO2] = 0.020).
Short i ('two conditions of equilibrium constant') is answered from 8.5/8.6: reversible reaction at equilibrium, closed system at constant temperature.
Answers beyond the chapter, labelled: short h (pressure lowers the melting point; heat taken from the ice-water system itself). The 9% larger volume of ice is from Chapter 5 (5.4.4).
